name: CESARops Field Command Unit training set
note: Every person, case, phone number and address here is made up. Sample sonar runs are real recordings shared with permission or under open licences; one recording's location and source are obscured. They are proxy data and not results for these cases.

subject.name: Ima Lostboater
subject.clothing: Bright yellow kayak, orange dry top, red helmet

lkp.text: Seen paddling about 1.5 nm off the Sheboygan breakwater by a charter captain

updates.text: Wind SW 15 kt, waves 3 ft. Search area set at 4 nm around the LKP.
Boat 1 on scene, running a creeping-line pattern north of the LKP.
Family briefed in plain words; they are waiting at the harbour cafe and have everything they need.

clues.text: Empty paddle float spotted floating by Boat 1
Orange dry-top glove found on the breakwater rocks

cases.family_report: Ima set out in a yellow kayak this morning and was last seen about a mile and a half off the Sheboygan breakwater. A boat crew and a helicopter crew are searching the area right now, and shore teams are checking the beaches. We found a paddle float this afternoon, which tells us where to look. We will call you at every update, even when there is nothing new. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

cases.area: Southern Lake Ontario, open water off the Wayne County shore, New York (area of the obscured sample recording)

subject.name: Justin Case
subject.clothing: Grey aluminium skiff, blue rain jacket

lkp.text: Skiff last seen at anchor, fishing, by a passing charter deckhand

updates.text: Skiff reported overdue at dusk. Search box set around the last sighting; wind light, visibility good.
Boat 1 completed two passes of the box with nothing seen on the surface.
Side-scan sweep of the LKP box requested. A real sample side-scan run is attached to this case as proxy data to practise reading a mosaic. It is not a search result for this case.

cases.family_report: Justin's skiff was last seen anchored and fishing on Lake Ontario. Boat crews have searched the surface twice. The next step is a sonar sweep of the lake bed near that spot, and a dive team is on standby. The sonar picture in this training case comes from a different, real recording and is only there so teams can practise. We will keep you informed. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

simulated.title: Drone thermal pass over the search box
simulated.text: Placeholder only. We do not have drone thermal imagery for this area. A real module would show a warm-body overlay here. Nothing on this card is a result.

subject.name: Rhoda Boat
subject.clothing: White sloop 'Knot Today', green foul-weather gear

lkp.text: Last radio check near the Apostle Islands; vessel overdue by four hours

updates.text: Overdue vessel report received; radio calls on channel 16 unanswered.
Fog bank over the outer islands. Air search waits for the ceiling to lift.
Sloop heard on a hand-held radio, weak, bearing east of Devils Island. Boat 5 tasked.

clues.text: Weak hand-held transmission, 'engine fine, just fog'

cases.family_report: Rhoda's sloop is overdue after a day sail among the Apostle Islands. We heard a weak radio call from the boat saying the engine is fine and she is in fog. A cutter is on its way to that area and a helicopter will go up when the fog lifts. This looks like a slow, foggy trip home rather than an emergency, but we are treating it seriously. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

subject.name: Dee Tour
subject.clothing: Red canoe, camouflage hat, no life jacket seen

lkp.text: Launched at a river ramp; did not return by dusk

updates.text: River stage rising; backwater sloughs prioritised for the shoreline teams.
Subject has diabetes; family confirms insulin was left in the car. Medical unit staged at the ramp.
Dee found cold, hungry and embarrassed on a sandbar island. Medic checking now.

clues.text: Red canoe seen drifting empty near a sandbar
Footprints and a small campfire on the sandbar island

cases.family_report: Good news: Dee has been found on a sandbar island south of the ramp. Dee is cold and hungry but talking and walking, and a medic is with Dee now. The canoe drifted away, which is why Dee could not paddle back. A boat will bring Dee to the ramp where you can meet. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

cases.area: Colorado River, Glen Canyon reach near Page, Arizona (area of the Humminbird sample recording)

subject.name: Al Most-Found
subject.clothing: Inflatable raft, tan hat, blue dry bag

lkp.text: Raft seen drifting low in the river at the lunch beach; no one answering

updates.text: Raft recovered empty and deflating at the lunch beach. Shoreline walk started.
Request for a side-scan pass of the pool below the beach. A real sample side-scan run from this stretch of river is attached as proxy data for practice. It is not a result for this case.

clues.text: Blue dry bag on the east bank, zipped, dry inside

cases.family_report: Al's raft was found at the river beach, but Al was not with it. Shoreline teams are walking both banks and a sonar team will look at the deeper pool nearby. Al is an experienced river hand who often walks off to take photographs, so there is reason for hope. We will call as soon as we know anything. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

simulated.title: Lidar shoreline map
simulated.text: Placeholder only. We do not have a lidar survey of this river bank. A real module would show terrain and overhangs here. Nothing on this card is a result.

cases.area: A lake in western Sweden (made-up visitor; area of the Lowrance sample recording)

lkp.text: Rowing boat seen tied to a dock; owner's car still in the car park at nightfall

updates.text: Exercise scenario: a visitor has not come back from an evening row. Shoreline teams walk the lake edge.
Real sample side-scan from a lake in this area is attached as proxy data for practice. It is not a result for this case.

clues.text: Wool cap hanging on a jetty post

cases.family_report: Sam rowed out in the evening and has not come back yet. The boat is tied up, and Sam's cap was found on a jetty, so we are searching the shoreline first. A sonar scan of the lake bottom is available if we need it. We will keep you up to date. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

subject.name: Mike Thetester
subject.clothing: Red jet ski, black wetsuit, white life jacket

lkp.text: Jet ski seen idling 2 nm north of the island ferry dock, rider waving

updates.text: Waves building from the west, 4 ft. Small craft advisory.
Boat 1 reached the jet ski, rider aboard, tired but fine; engine would not restart. Tow under way.

clues.text: Jet ski located drifting, rider waving

cases.family_report: Mike's jet ski stopped working on the lake and he drifted in rising waves. A rescue boat has reached him and he is safe, tired, and being towed to shore. He asked us to tell you he is sorry about the missed dinner. [FICTITIOUS - training data]

subject.name: Hal Lifejacket
subject.clothing: Stand-up paddleboard, striped shirt, lifejacket worn

lkp.text: Paddleboard seen heading toward the far shore at dusk

updates.text: Lake calm, good visibility. Marine unit searches the far shore; shore teams cover the public beaches.
Hal found sitting on the far dock with a flat paddleboard battery pump. He had no phone signal.

clues.text: Board and paddler located at a private dock on the far shore

cases.family_report: Hal has been found safe on a dock on the far side of Green Lake. His board lost air and he had no phone signal, so he could not call. He is wearing his lifejacket, is warm, and is being brought back by boat. [FICTITIOUS - training data]
